description: Compares every channel of a polyphonic cable against a threshold and gives gates for above and below, plus the signal itself split the same way

params.text: Sets the voltage each channel is compared against, -10V to 10V
Scales the threshold CV before it is added to the threshold knob, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Added to the threshold knob after the attenuator, channel for channel, with the total held between -10V and 10V
The signal to be compared, one channel at a time; its channel count is passed to all four outputs

outputs.text: Carries 10V on each channel whose input is above the threshold, and 0V on the rest
Carries 10V on each channel whose input is at or below the threshold, and 0V on the rest
Carries the input on each channel that is above the threshold, and 0V on the rest
Carries the input on each channel that is at or below the threshold, and 0V on the rest

notes: the comparison is made afresh every sample with no smoothing, so this works at audio rate for hard splitting as well as at modulation rate
the threshold jack is read channel by channel, so a polyphonic cable there gives each channel its own threshold
the two lamps follow the last channel of the cable rather than the whole of it, so with more than one channel patched they do not show the state of the first

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±10V.
